content_sections.heading: C-DOT Young Professional Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available for the post of Young Professional – Product Engineering & Sustenance.

rows.qualification_required: B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, or related disciplines from a recognized University/Institute (Mandatory) by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU)/UGC/AICTE. Minimum Percentage 70% in 10th, 12th, and Graduation.

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Young Professional Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 35 years as on the last date of accepting applications.

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Young Professional Salary
content_sections.text: The engagement is contractual (2 yrs initially + 1 yr extension based on performance & project requirement).

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Young Professional Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Young Professional Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of initial screening based on academic qualification, experience, and other parameters, followed by a two-level interview process. First-Level Interview Process: Online. Second-Level Interview Process: Offline / In person.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for C-DOT Young Professional
content_sections.text: Visit the official C-DOT website at www.cdot.in (Careers) and read all eligibility conditions carefully. Ensure you have a valid and active email ID and mobile number. Fill in all the required details in the online application form accurately. Click the 'Submit' button after completing the form. Note that once submitted, no requests for corrections or representations will be entertained. Take a printout of the submitted application form and retain it for your records. Do not send any hard copy or printed application to C-DOT.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of Date of Birth (DOB) Matriculation Certificate Graduation / Post Graduation Degree and Certificates Experience / Service Certificates NOC (if applicable)

faq.question: Q1. What is the C-DOT Young Professional recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the Center for Development of Telematics (C-DOT) to hire 5 Young Professionals for Product Engineering & Sustenance on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies are available for the Young Professional – Product Engineering & Sustenance post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for C-DOT Young Professional recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online applications is 30 days from the date of publication of the notification in Employment News - English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, or related disciplines with a minimum of 70% marks in 10th, 12th, and Graduation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as on the last date of accepting applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The notified CTC is 12Lac/annum.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the C-DOT Young Professional post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official C-DOT website at www.cdot.in under the Careers section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes initial screening based on academic qualifications and experience, followed by a two-level interview process (Online First-Level and Offline/In-person Second-Level).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of 2 years, with a possible 1-year extension based on performance and project requirements.
